evals.prompt: Review the latest changes in https://github.com/zackb/tether since the last upstream review recorded in the repository. Identify any newly expanded core or user-facing features that tether-web does not implement, then update the root future-features.md with rich checkbox items and a new review checkpoint. Preserve unrelated existing notes.
evals.expected_output: The root future-features.md is created or updated with an immutable upstream range, evidence-backed missing/partial parity items, implementation touchpoints, acceptance criteria, and a review log. Existing items are preserved and duplicates are reconciled.

evals.prompt: Run an incremental parity audit of zackb/tether. There is already a future-features.md with older checklist items and an upstream checkpoint. Review only changes after that checkpoint, determine which items are still missing versus implemented in ui/src, add only genuinely new work, and update the checkpoint and review log.
evals.expected_output: Only post-checkpoint upstream changes are considered; the existing backlog remains intact, duplicate or completed items are reconciled with evidence, and new entries identify protocol/GTK behavior, local web touchpoints, parity states, and acceptance criteria.

evals.prompt: Audit recent upstream Tether changes for web parity, paying special attention to protocol fixes, reconnect behavior, and new GTK actions. Separate true feature-surface expansion from maintenance-only changes, and update future-features.md only for missing or partial user outcomes. Do not invent a web-specific daemon route.
evals.expected_output: The audit classifies candidates with evidence, excludes maintenance-only changes, records any missing or partial feature with lifecycle/protocol implications, and explicitly documents blockers when the upstream protocol is insufficient.
